task.title: P6-169: Stop cloning a whole page of CardSummary on every reactive read
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 8 — Performance). Original id: P6-169. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`results.get().map(|p| p.search)` clones a whole page of `CardSummary` on every reactive read, in two separate Effects** (was `P6-009e`; `catalog.rs:228`, `:307`).
